claude-desktop-bridge._comment: Claude Desktop / Claude Code through localhost HTTP: one mcp-remote bridge entry under mcpServers in ~/.claude.json. Use the absolute npx path from `which npx`. Remove any older memory-arbiter entry that launches mema directly, or Claude will start a second process. mcp-remote is a third-party bridge; 0.1.43 is the version tested with mema. After changing the file, fully quit and reopen Claude Desktop and restart Claude Code sessions.
